Food $174; comps $16.35 (0.6%; industry, F&F, Neuhoff resident). 86 guests; check avg $34.43. Excellent Tuesday hosting the East Nashville Care Market: sleepy start, then picked up significantly at the 7pm kickoff. Clayton and Carter attended with Mr. Black and Pickers/Borchetta and colleagues; the host was effusive with praise for the team and bar. Crowd dispersed over the following hour, final event guests out near 10:30pm; late-night regulars and industry in the last hour. Kitchen: John Michael held it down while training Rick. 86 ponies, Guinness, hazy IPA, jalapeño poppers, GF buns; low CVT, tonic, aquavit. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 11/17 (MOD Kyler, Chef Michael; entered by Max K; posted 1:38am ET 11/18)** Net $5,092 vs target $4,448 (114.5%). Food $395, beverage $4,692, retail $0; no events; comps $37 (0.7%). 140 guests (SevenRooms); check avg $36.37 (net/guests; form $36). Stuttering start with a handful of reservations, mostly celebrations grabbing a drink before dinner; filled back up completely by 9pm, busy enough to seat a couple at standing room. Then a blur of dates, cocktail pilgrims and after-work friends; solo regulars at the bar. Night capped by a 5-top from Maine returning after 10 years, which kept late sales high; late guests included the neighborhood DJ and a Brooklyn restaurant manager with family ties to former staff. Door: full until ~11:30pm, mostly 2-tops, small waitlist, last party sat 12:15am. 1 no-show (not charged). Menu count 20/20. Breakage: 1 DOF, 1 SOF, 1 sidecar bottom.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 11/17 (MOD Julian, Chef Angel; entered by Julian Catano; posted 3:48am ET 11/18)** Net $4,484 vs target $4,437 (101.1%). All Marquee ($4,484; food $791); Standing Room $0; no events; comps $183 (4.1%; gifts $123, DNL $40, discounts $19.30). 115 guests; check avg $39.00. A handful of guests right at open, steady through the after-dinner hours, then a real late rush around 11pm with 5–6 parties. An industry group opening a bar in the Las Vegas arts district came in with lots of questions about the drinks. Busy night for two bartenders and one server, with a full house for a solid stretch — all hands on deck. Newest server did a great job on the floor. Kitchen: Angel solo on service while Josh prepped for tomorrow's Standing Room event. Maintenance: oven still down. 86 cookies, pot de crème. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 11/17 (MOD Marcus; entered by Marcus; posted 2:00am ET 11/18)** Net $9,964.22 (form 'Total Net Sales Including Events') vs target $3,894 (255.9%). Note: this includes $6,138 of event sales from an 11/7 event that was entered in the POS today; Marquee bar sales for the night itself were $4,923.63 (126.4% of target), and the form's figures don't fully reconcile ($4,923.63 + $6,138 = $11,061.63). Garden $0; food $737; discounts $79 (gift $10, service recovery $69). 128 guests (95 walk-ins, 33 reservations); check avg $77.85 (net/guests; form $79.71). With nearly 40 on the books, Devan moved to the floor and Marcus hosted. Strong start — bar filled fast and the room stayed full all night, with a short waitlist a couple of times; many guests from the neuroscience convention. Oyster Tuesday still a big hit. Bar had lots of turns without getting overwhelmed. Kitchen: big food night, oysters the top seller; consider pre-shucking and cleaning half shells ahead on Tuesdays to keep ticket times down. Kitchen close not checked. Incident reported: a blocked kitchen floor drain leaked into the space below, affecting The Dabney's stairs during their service; a plumber is being booked to inspect all floor drains. No-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.weather: Cool, high of 54, scattered clouds and partly sunny
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 11/17 (MOD Belle; entered by Belle; posted 3:44am ET 11/18)** Net $6,613 vs target $7,764 (85.2%). Food $1,374; no events; comps $518.56 (7.8%; mostly Surprise & Delights for birthdays and anniversaries, plus members, industry, a team member's parents, 2 DNLs). 147 guests; check avg $44.98. Curtis off, Belle MOD with support from Malachi. Slower Tuesday than recent weeks: quiet start, busiest stretch from ~6pm; waitlist worked through efficiently. Several guests lingered for hours without blocking seating. Floor and bar ran smoothly; bartender cut ~9pm plus an early cut. Elevated comps nearly all from taking care of members who brought in guests — positive feedback and interest in returning. The last of the leftover event batches were used up as mini-cocktail Surprise & Delights, which guests have loved as an alternative to bubbles. Kitchen: close to doubling the food sales target; good progress on prep, organization and cleaning; family meal ready near the start of service. No incidents; no-shows not charged.
